Act as an ontology engineer. Use the following content (examples, part of the ontology, and a list of guidelines) as a guide to translate the natural language rule you are given into a SWRL rule. 
  EXAMPLES
    Example 1
    Rule in natural language: If a person has a sibling who is a man, then the person has a brother.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasSibling(?p, ?s) ^ Person(?s) ^ IsMan(?s, true) -> hasBrother(?p, ?s)

    Example 2
    Rule in natural language: if a person has a phone number that starts with '+', then the person has an international phone number.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasPhoneNumber(?p, ?number) ^ swrlb:startsWith(?number, "+") -> hasInternationalPhoneNumber(?p, true)

    Example 3
    Rule in natural language:  if a person has age greater than 17, then the person is an adult and has id card.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasAge(?p, ?age) ^ Age(?age) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?age, 17) ^ IdCard(?id) -> Adult(?p) ^ hasIdCard(?p, ?id)

    Example 4
    Rule in natural language: if a publication has two different authors, then those authors have cooperated with each other.
    SWRL rule: Publication(?p) ^ Author(?y) ^ Author(?z) ^ hasAuthor(?p, ?y) ^ hasAuthor(?p, ?z) ^ differentFrom(?y, ?z) -> cooperatedWith(?y, ?z)

    Example 5
    Rule in natural language: if a researcher has published more than 10 papers in a Top-Tier conference, then the researcher is a prominent researcher and has a high citation impact.
    SWRL rule: Researcher(?r) ^ hasPublished(?r, ?c) ^ Conference(?c) ^ topTierConference(?c) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(count(?c), 10) -> ProminentResearcher(?r) ^ hasHighCitationImpact(?r, true)
  END OF EXAMPLES
  PART OF ONTOLOGY 
    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.case.edu/MDO#Tremor">
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">symptom of PD, usually observed at patient's hands</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Tremor</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://www.case.edu/PMDO#BradykinesiaofUpperLimb -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.case.edu/PMDO#BradykinesiaofUpperLimb">
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">symptom of PD, usually observed at patient's legs</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Bradykinesia of Upper Limb</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/FeatureOfInterest -->

    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/FeatureOfInterest">
        <owl:equivalentClass rdf:resource="https://saref.etsi.org/core/FeatureOfInterest"/>
    </rdf:Description>
    


    <!-- https://dahcc.idlab.ugent.be/Ontology/SensorsAndWearables/Accelerometer -->
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#DailyDosagePlan">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#MedicalPrescription"/>
        <rdfs:subClassOf>
            <owl:Restriction>
                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasDosageTime"/>
                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#DosageTime"/>
            </owl:Restriction>
        </rdfs:subClassOf>
        <rdfs:comment>Daily dosage plan for patient (4 times one day)</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>Daily Dosage Plan</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#Diagnosis -->
<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasBradykinisiaOfUpperLimp">
        <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#topDataProperty"/>
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://schema.org/Person"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean"/>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has bradykinisia of upper limp</rdfs:label>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasDepression -->

    <owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasDepression">
        <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#topDataProperty"/>
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://schema.org/Person"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean"/>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has depression</rdfs:label>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasDysphagia -->
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#WalkingActivity">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.case.edu/MDO#ActivitiesofDailyLiving"/>
        <rdfs:subClassOf>
            <owl:Restriction>
                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="https://saref.etsi.org/core/isMeasuredByDevice"/>
                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#SmartWatch"/>
            </owl:Restriction>
        </rdfs:subClassOf>
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">An activity followed by the patient during his free time, using his hands (walking).</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Walking Activity</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://www.case.edu/MDO#ActivitiesofDailyLiving -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.case.edu/MDO#ActivitiesofDailyLiving"/>
    


    <!-- http://www.case.edu/MDO#Tremor -->
<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasStartTime">
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Observation"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime"/>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasSubstance -->

    <owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasSubstance">
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#MedicalPrescription"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string"/>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasTremor -->
<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasTremor">
        <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#topDataProperty"/>
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://schema.org/Person"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean"/>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has tremor</rdfs:label>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#heartRate -->

    <owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#heartRate">
        <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#topDataProperty"/>
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://schema.org/Person"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal"/>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">heart rate</rdfs:label>
    </owl:DatatypeProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#levelHoehnYahrStage -->
<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasDosageTime">
        <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasTime"/>
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#DailyDosagePlan"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#DosageTime"/>
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">the dosing time of a patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has Dosage Time</rdfs:label>
    </owl:ObjectProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasPersonalHealthRecord -->
  END OF ONTOLOGY
  
  COMMON GUIDELINES

  Please try to implement the following guidelines:
  1: Variables e.g., (?something) used in Conclusions must be present in Conditions. So create as many variables as needed in Conditions. 
  2: Each atom must have exactly one variable if it represents class.
  3: Each atom must have exactly two variables if it represents object property.
  4: Each concept must be represented by a class and must be present in Conditions.

  END OF COMMON GUIDELINES

  The rule in natural language is the following: If a patient with Parkinson disease has a dose plan every 4 hours, and tremor and bradykinesia of the upper limb is identified within the boundaries of this interval then send notification to the doctor for action.
  Give only the final SWRL rule

Here is the final SWRL rule:

Patient(?p) ^ hasParkinsonDisease(?p, true) ^ DailyDosagePlan(?d) ^ hasDosageTime(?d, ?t1) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?t1, 0) ^ swrlb:lessThanOrEqual(?t2, 4) ^ swrlb:add(?t1, ?t2, ?t3) ^ swrlb:eq(?t3, 0) ^ hasTremor(?p, true) ^ hasBradykinesiaOfUpperLimb(?p, true) -> sendNotificationToDoctorForAction(?p)

Note: I assumed that the notification is sent to the doctor for action when the patient has both tremor and bradykinesia of the upper limb within the 4-hour interval. If this is not the case, please let me know and I will adjust the rule accordingly.
